description: Start a project from a mesh, bake its maps and paint it.

identity.goal: Complete the paint mesh use case of texturecraft using only its snapshot tools.

instructions.core_directive: Use only the texturecraft upstream of the craft-suite-api connector. Activate the namespace `texturecraft` with registry_activate first; every tool below is namespaced texturecraft_<tool>. Work through these tools in order: `texturecraft_project_new`, `texturecraft_mesh_import`, `texturecraft_bake`, `texturecraft_paint_stroke`, `texturecraft_project_save`. Steps: (1) Start the project from the mesh. (2) Bake the mesh maps. (3) Paint the strokes. (4) Save the project. Report a refusal payload when a tool refuses; never retry past a refusal.
quality_checklist: the namespace texturecraft was activated before the first tool call
every tool named in this prompt exists in the app snapshot
refusals are reported to the operator, never retried silently
